name: Pipotiazine
summary: Pipotiazine (Piportil), also known as pipothiazine, is a typical antipsychotic of the phenothiazine class used in the United Kingdom and other countries for the treatment of schizophrenia. Its properties are similar to those of chlorpromazine. A 2004 systematic review investigated its efficacy for people with schizophrenia:

pharmacology.text: Its properties are similar to those of chlorpromazine.

uses.text: Pipotiazine palmitate is used to treat schizophrenia.

sideEffects.en: Common effects include drowsiness, weight gain and low blood pressure. It often causes movement problems such as stiffness, tremor and restlessness, long-term use can cause tardive dyskinesia, and it can rarely trigger neuroleptic malignant syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 常見副作用包括嗜睡、體重增加和血壓偏低。它常引起肌肉僵硬、顫抖和坐立不安等動作問題，長期使用可能導致遲發性運動障礙，少數情況下可能引發抗精神病藥惡性症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 常见副作用包括嗜睡、体重增加和血压偏低。它常引起肌肉僵硬、颤抖和坐立不安等动作问题，长期使用可能导致迟发性运动障碍，少数情况下可能引发抗精神病药恶性症候群。

fact.en: Pipotiazine was often given as pipotiazine palmitate, a fatty ester injected into muscle. The fat-like tail makes the drug seep out slowly, so injections can be spaced far apart.
fact.zh: Pipotiazine 常以棕櫚酸酯的形式肌肉注射。這條類似脂肪的尾巴讓藥物緩慢釋出，所以注射間隔可以拉得很長。
fact.zhHans: Pipotiazine 常以棕榈酸酯的形式肌肉注射。这条类似脂肪的尾巴让药物缓慢发布，所以注射间隔可以拉得很长。
